name: marketing-board
description: Eight-seat marketing deliberation board for SaaS launches. Mirrors `ceo-board` pattern: 8 specialist subagents (Ethnographer, Storyteller, Channel Strategist, Producer, Funnel Engineer, Community/PR Lead, Moonshot, Contrarian) plus a `/marketing-board` slash command, a `:bootstrap` skill that scaffolds the product knowledge base, and an `:email-sequence` skill that drafts ESP-paste-ready email sequences from a saved Marketing Plan Memo.
